function.name: VarCyMul
function.signature: HRESULT WINAPI VarCyMul(CY cyLeft, CY cyRight, CY* pCyOut)
function.header_comment:
/************************************************************************
 * VarCyMul (OLEAUT32.303)
 *
 * Multiply one CY by another.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  cyLeft  [I] Source
 *  cyRight [I] Value to multiply by
 *  pCyOut  [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  Success: S_OK.
 *  Failure: DISP_E_OVERFLOW, if the value will not fit in the destination
 */
